limit.description: The number of resources to be returned.

offset.description: Determines your position in the list for pagination. To ensure that the next page is retrieved correctly, always set offset to the value of next_offset obtained in the previous iteration of the API call.

include_deleted.description: If set to true, includes the deleted resources in the response. For the deleted resources in the response, the 'deleted' attribute will be 'true'.

is_voided.description: Will be true if the charge has been voided. Usually the unbilled charge will be voided and revised to different charges(s) during proration.

subscription_id.description:

A unique identifier for the subscription this charge belongs to.
Supported operators : is, is_not, starts_with, is_present, in, not_in

Example → subscription_id[is] = "5hjdk8nOpd0b12"

chargebee-request-origin-device.description: The device from which the customer has made the request

chargebee-request-origin-user.description: The email address of your customer/user. Use this when the email address has only ASCII characters.

chargebee-request-origin-user-encoded.description: The Base64-encoded email address of your customer/user. Use this if the email address has UTF-8 characters. When this header is provided, the header \`chargebee-request-origin-user\` is ignored.

chargebee-request-origin-ip.description: The IP address of the customer where the request originated

chargebee-business-entity-id.description: If the site has multiple business entities, you can use this custom HTTP header to specify the business entity for which Chargebee should perform the operation.
